description: This Java source file defines the ContentBoxesController class, a Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations for content boxes within the admin interface of a sales management system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, viewing details, and saving content box entities, handling localization, and positioning details.

classes.name: ContentBoxesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling admin operations for content boxes, including listing, creating, editing, and saving content box entities.

methods.name: boxPositions
methods.description: Provides a set of predefined position options ('LEFT' and 'RIGHT') for content boxes.

methods.name: listContentBoxes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all content boxes in the admin interface.

methods.name: createBox
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initiate creation of a new content box, initializing necessary model attributes.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch and display details of a specific content box by ID.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content box entity, including validation and localization handling.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items and current menu context in the model for view rendering.
